skills.name: Review objective evidence
skills.output: Objective scorecard with source references and evidence gaps
skills.note: Trace progress against adopted objectives and flag gaps that require an owner.

skills.name: Prepare a decision brief
skills.output: Decision brief with options, dependencies and proposed owners
skills.note: Connect a pending leadership decision to the commitments it changes.

skills.name: Summarize portfolio impact
skills.output: Portfolio impact brief ordered by affected objectives and Work
skills.note: Group changes by business impact and identify the Work that requires leadership attention.

workflows.name: Executive operating review
workflows.trigger: The executive team opens its scheduled operating review.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing changes to objectives, owners or executive commitments

workflows.output: Operating review brief and owned follow-up Work
workflows.verification: Match scorecard figures to their source versions and confirm accepted follow-ups have owners and dates.
workflows.note: Move from current KPI evidence to an owned leadership review.

workflows.name: Leadership decision follow-through
workflows.trigger: A strategic decision is requested or an adopted commitment changes.

approval.requiredFor: Adopting a decision and committing teams to its consequences

workflows.output: Versioned decision and linked commitments
workflows.verification: Read back the decision version and confirm affected Work links and owner acknowledgments.
workflows.note: Carry leadership decisions into the Work they affect.

skills.name: Qualify deal evidence
skills.output: Opportunity brief with verified signals and missing qualification evidence
skills.note: Check stage evidence and buyer commitments against the authorized account context.

skills.name: Review forecast assumptions
skills.output: Forecast variance brief with traceable deals and assumptions
skills.note: Explain movements in the forecast and call out assumptions that need seller confirmation.

skills.name: Prepare a closed-won handoff
skills.output: Account Success handoff brief linked to the originating Work
skills.note: Carry customer objectives, stakeholders and commitments into post-sale ownership.

workflows.name: Pipeline and forecast review
workflows.trigger: A pipeline review starts or forecast assumptions materially change.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing forecast revisions or changing opportunity commitments

workflows.output: Approved forecast snapshot and deal follow-ups
workflows.verification: Compare adopted totals to the CRM snapshot and read back approved deal updates.
workflows.note: Review the deals behind forecast changes before committing a revised number.

workflows.name: Closed-won transition to Account Success
workflows.trigger: The source opportunity records a closed-won transition.

approval.reviewer: Sales owner and receiving Account Success owner
approval.requiredFor: Confirming the handoff scope and acceptance of transferred commitments

workflows.output: Accepted handoff with an accountable next owner
workflows.verification: Verify Account ID, originating Work ID and the receiving owner's acknowledgment.
workflows.note: Keep the customer commitments traceable when responsibility passes from Sales to Account Success.

skills.name: Reconcile pipeline records
skills.output: Discrepancy register with source versions and affected records
skills.note: Identify duplicate, stale and conflicting CRM records that distort reporting.

skills.name: Diagnose funnel changes
skills.output: Funnel variance brief with impacted stages and evidence gaps
skills.note: Compare conversion and aging against the authorized funnel definitions.

skills.name: Assess routing change impact
skills.output: Proposed routing change with affected owners and verification conditions
skills.note: Prepare the impact case for an ownership, territory or routing change.

workflows.name: Revenue data quality review
workflows.trigger: A reporting close, drift signal or data quality review identifies discrepancies.

approval.requiredFor: Applying source record corrections or changes to reporting definitions

workflows.output: Reviewed discrepancy queue and reconciliation evidence
workflows.verification: Recalculate reconciled totals from the authoritative source and confirm receipts for approved corrections.
workflows.note: Trace revenue reporting problems to source record and definition changes.

workflows.name: Routing and ownership change
workflows.trigger: A territory, routing or data ownership change is proposed.

approval.requiredFor: Activating the exact revised rule and its ownership impact

workflows.output: Versioned routing proposal and verification plan
workflows.verification: Read back the activated rule version and compare approved sample assignments to expected ownership.
workflows.note: Review how a rule change will affect current accounts and opportunities.

skills.name: Explain account health
skills.output: Account health brief with cited drivers and confidence gaps
skills.note: Explain changes in account health using evidence linked to the authorized Account ID.

skills.name: Assess renewal readiness
skills.output: Renewal brief with value evidence, owners and decision dates
skills.note: Identify open obligations and evidence needed before a renewal decision.

skills.name: Prepare a success plan
skills.output: Draft success plan with milestones, dependencies and proposed owners
skills.note: Align proposed actions to the customer's recorded objectives and known risks.

skills.name: Investigate integration health
skills.output: Technical health brief with confirmed signals and investigation priorities
skills.note: Correlate recent integration changes with observed customer impact.

skills.name: Prepare a technical escalation
skills.output: Engineering handoff with severity, impact, Work ID and evidence
skills.note: Package the authorized evidence an engineering owner needs to act on a customer blocker.

skills.name: Review implementation readiness
skills.output: Readiness brief with customer acceptance, open risks and validation evidence
skills.note: Check implementation gates against agreed criteria and identify unresolved blockers.

workflows.name: At-risk account intervention
workflows.trigger: An account health change or an open customer commitment crosses a review threshold.

approval.requiredFor: Changing the recovery plan or sending a customer commitment

workflows.output: Risk response plan with owner, next action and review date
workflows.verification: Confirm the risk and approved actions on the same Account ID and read back the updated plan.
workflows.note: Trace an account risk from evidence through the approved response.

workflows.name: Renewal and value review
workflows.trigger: An account enters its renewal review period.

approval.reviewer: Account Success and authorized commercial owner
approval.requiredFor: Sharing a renewal proposal or commercial commitment

workflows.output: Renewal readiness and value brief
workflows.verification: Confirm dates, renewal terms and accepted next steps against the authorized account sources.
workflows.note: Review customer value and open commitments before the renewal decision.

workflows.name: Technical account escalation
workflows.trigger: A technical blocker or integration incident affects an authorized customer account.

approval.reviewer: Technical account owner and authorized incident lead
approval.requiredFor: Escalating customer data or sending a technical commitment outside the team

workflows.output: Escalated Work with evidence, owner and customer-impact checkpoint
workflows.verification: Match the engineering receipt, Account ID and Work ID. Confirm the impact and any recovery claim against current telemetry.
workflows.note: Hand off customer technical evidence while preserving account scope and the same Work record.

workflows.name: Technical implementation readiness review
workflows.trigger: A customer implementation reaches a technical acceptance milestone.

approval.reviewer: Authorized technical lead and customer acceptance owner
approval.requiredFor: Recording production readiness or accepting a milestone exception

workflows.output: Reviewed technical milestone with acceptance and validation evidence
workflows.verification: Confirm test results, approved exceptions and customer acceptance against the exact milestone version.
workflows.note: Carry implementation readiness decisions into continued Account Success Work.

skills.name: Triage case evidence
skills.output: Case triage brief with urgency, owner and escalation criteria
skills.note: Identify operational impact and tie the case to its authorized customer and related incidents.

skills.name: Draft an evidence-based response
skills.output: Reviewed-source response draft with evidence references
skills.note: Prepare a response using permitted case evidence and verified knowledge.

skills.name: Verify resolution evidence
skills.output: Resolution brief with remaining follow-up and customer verification
skills.note: Establish whether the observed customer issue is resolved before recommending closure.

workflows.name: Case triage and escalation
workflows.trigger: A new priority case arrives or a service target is at risk.

approval.requiredFor: External escalation or commitments beyond the current support authority

workflows.output: Case escalation with acknowledged ownership and response draft
workflows.verification: Confirm the case receipt, queue assignment, active clock and accepted next action.
workflows.note: Move a case to the right owner with enough evidence for immediate follow-up.

workflows.name: Case closeout and customer follow-up
workflows.trigger: The assigned team records a possible resolution.

approval.requiredFor: Sending a customer follow-up or closing a case under review

workflows.output: Verified case outcome and approved customer follow-up
workflows.verification: Read back the source case status and verify the resolution evidence and any communication receipt.
workflows.note: Close support Work after verifying the observed result and next customer commitment.

skills.name: Prepare a campaign brief
skills.output: Campaign brief with audience, messaging, owner and success measures
skills.note: Align campaign planning to adopted objectives and approved source material.

skills.name: Review audience readiness
skills.output: Audience readiness brief with evidence and unresolved approval checks
skills.note: Surface missing audience approvals and confirm launch dependencies.

skills.name: Explain campaign performance
skills.output: Performance brief with contributing channels and attribution limits
skills.note: Compare outcomes to agreed campaign measures and explain supported changes.

workflows.name: Campaign launch readiness
workflows.trigger: A campaign enters launch review.

approval.reviewer: Authorized campaign owner and responsible reviewer
approval.requiredFor: Publishing the approved assets, audience and launch plan

workflows.output: Reviewed campaign launch plan with asset and audience versions
workflows.verification: Match the provider's observed campaign, audience and published asset versions to the approved plan.
workflows.note: Carry the campaign brief and audience evidence through the final launch decision.

workflows.name: Campaign performance review
workflows.trigger: A campaign reaches a reporting checkpoint or performance materially changes.

approval.requiredFor: Changing campaign spend, targeting or public assets

workflows.output: Performance review with proposed experiments and evidence
workflows.verification: Compare reported metrics to the approved attribution window and record any adopted change and its owner.
workflows.note: Translate performance evidence into reviewable campaign adjustments.

skills.name: Reconcile invoice evidence
skills.output: Invoice reconciliation list with matched receipts and unresolved differences
skills.note: Match amounts, currencies and record versions across permitted billing and payment evidence.

skills.name: Explain financial variance
skills.output: Source-backed variance brief with timing and data gaps
skills.note: Explain observed variances against the approved baseline and surface unresolved items for Finance.

skills.name: Prepare a billing exception
skills.output: Billing exception brief with proposed resolution and expected readback
skills.note: Gather the relevant invoice and contract evidence before preparing an exception for review.

workflows.name: Period close evidence review
workflows.trigger: Finance opens a reporting period close.

approval.requiredFor: Posting adjustments or accepting unresolved close exceptions

workflows.output: Reconciled close review with exceptions, owners and supporting evidence
workflows.verification: Compare approved figures to source balances and confirm receipts for any posted adjustments.
workflows.note: Review close evidence and disputed balances before recording period outcomes.

workflows.name: Billing exception resolution
workflows.trigger: A disputed charge or reconciliation difference is raised.

approval.requiredFor: Applying a credit, adjustment or other source-system billing change

workflows.output: Documented billing decision and independent readback
workflows.verification: Verify the expected amount, currency and invoice status against the billing provider receipt and readback.
workflows.note: Resolve billing exceptions with approval and source evidence.

skills.name: Trace process handoffs
skills.output: Process map with pending handoffs, owners and blocking commitments
skills.note: Identify where ownership changes and what evidence a receiving team needs.

skills.name: Analyze process cycle time
skills.output: Bottleneck brief with elapsed-time breakdown and source context
skills.note: Compare observed cycle time against operating targets and identify recurring delays.

skills.name: Review runbook readiness
skills.output: Runbook revision brief with control checks and validation criteria
skills.note: Compare the proposed runbook to current practice and identify missing controls or owners.

workflows.name: Process exception response
workflows.trigger: Work stalls at a handoff or misses an operating target.

approval.requiredFor: Changing ownership, deadlines or exception treatment

workflows.output: Owned exception response with a restart or escalation decision
workflows.verification: Confirm the receiving owner, updated deadline and next checkpoint on the same Work ID.
workflows.note: Route an operating exception through the owner who can resolve the blockage.

workflows.name: Governed runbook change
workflows.trigger: A recurring exception or process change warrants a runbook revision.

approval.requiredFor: Publishing the new runbook version

workflows.output: Approved runbook revision and validation record
workflows.verification: Read back the published version and check a representative case against the approved handoff and controls.
workflows.note: Turn recurring process evidence into a reviewable runbook improvement.

skills.name: Synthesize product feedback
skills.output: Evidence-linked feedback themes with affected customers and gaps
skills.note: Group related requests and connect them to account context where authorized.

skills.name: Assess feature adoption
skills.output: Adoption brief with measured usage and unresolved friction
skills.note: Compare usage against adopted success criteria and identify follow-up needs.

skills.name: Prepare a roadmap priority brief
skills.output: Roadmap options with evidence, trade-offs and known dependencies
skills.note: Compare candidate Work against customer needs, objectives and delivery dependencies.

workflows.name: Discovery and roadmap prioritization
workflows.trigger: A discovery review considers new product opportunities.

approval.requiredFor: Changing adopted roadmap priorities or communicating commitments

workflows.output: Versioned priority decision with evidence and next discovery actions
workflows.verification: Confirm the roadmap decision version, affected Work IDs and any communicated commitments.
workflows.note: Carry product discovery evidence into an owned prioritization decision.

workflows.name: Feature release adoption review
workflows.trigger: A released feature reaches an adoption checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: Recording a release outcome or committing corrective work

workflows.output: Release adoption review with agreed success measures and follow-up
workflows.verification: Compare reported adoption to the approved measurement window and confirm owned follow-up Work.
workflows.note: Review observed usage and customer friction after a release.

skills.name: Assemble incident evidence
skills.output: Incident timeline with affected services and verified observations
skills.note: Match operational symptoms to deployments and dependencies using the permitted evidence.

skills.name: Assess release readiness
skills.output: Readiness brief with test coverage, change risk and rollback checks
skills.note: Identify missing validation and confirm the expected outcome for the release candidate.

skills.name: Assess delivery risk
skills.output: Delivery risk brief with dependencies, owners and checkpoints
skills.note: Trace dependencies and commitments that could affect the delivery plan.

workflows.name: Incident coordination and recovery verification
workflows.trigger: On-call confirms an incident affecting a supported service.

approval.reviewer: Authorized incident commander or change owner
approval.requiredFor: Applying a production mitigation or publishing an external status update

workflows.output: Incident record with verified recovery evidence and follow-up Work
workflows.verification: Match mitigation receipts to the incident and confirm sustained recovery from observed service telemetry.
workflows.note: Keep incident impact, mitigation and recovery traceable in one Work record.

workflows.name: Release readiness and verification
workflows.trigger: A release candidate is submitted for go-live review.

approval.requiredFor: Deploying the exact reviewed release candidate

workflows.output: Release decision with acceptance evidence and observed rollout status
workflows.verification: Confirm deployed version, health indicators and acceptance results against the approved release plan.
workflows.note: Connect release approval to independent evidence of the actual rollout.

skills.name: Prepare hiring process coordination
skills.output: Process brief with interview schedules, owners and outstanding steps
skills.note: Track authorized recruiting process tasks and route human hiring decisions to their owners.

skills.name: Review employee onboarding readiness
skills.output: Onboarding readiness brief with restricted references and responsible owners
skills.note: Identify outstanding onboarding work from access-controlled People context.

skills.name: Find approved People policy
skills.output: Policy references and questions for the authorized People owner
skills.note: Retrieve policy versions applicable to the requested process and surface items for human review.

workflows.name: Hiring process coordination review
workflows.trigger: An approved requisition reaches a scheduling or process checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: External candidate communication or an approved process exception

workflows.output: Recruiting process checklist with owners and outstanding actions
workflows.verification: Confirm the approved schedule and recruiting system receipts using permitted references.
workflows.note: Keep recruiting logistics and policy evidence available to authorized human decision owners.

workflows.name: Employee onboarding readiness review
workflows.trigger: An authorized new-joiner case reaches its pre-start checkpoint.

approval.reviewer: Authorized People owner and access approver
approval.requiredFor: Granting access or approving an onboarding exception

workflows.output: Onboarding checklist with verified readiness and outstanding tasks
workflows.verification: Read back approved access and task statuses from the responsible source systems.
workflows.note: Coordinate new-joiner tasks while preserving employee record permissions.

skills.name: Prepare a contract review packet
skills.output: Versioned review packet with sourced differences and questions for counsel
skills.note: Collect changed clauses and policy references for the authorized legal reviewer.

skills.name: Index approved obligations
skills.output: Obligation review list with source references, dates and owners
skills.note: Trace approved obligations to agreement evidence and identify follow-ups for counsel.

skills.name: Assemble compliance control evidence
skills.output: Control evidence packet with scope, dates and evidence gaps
skills.note: Link control evidence to the applicable Work and record gaps requiring a human decision.

workflows.name: Contract review and approval
workflows.trigger: An authorized contract draft enters review.

approval.requiredFor: Approving final terms or releasing a document for signature

workflows.output: Reviewed contract version and linked obligations for follow-up
workflows.verification: Compare the approved and signed document versions and confirm the accepted obligations.
workflows.note: Give human reviewers the version and clause evidence needed to approve the exact agreement.

workflows.name: Compliance evidence and obligations review
workflows.trigger: A compliance control or confirmed obligation reaches a review checkpoint.

approval.requiredFor: Attesting control completion or signing off on a finding

workflows.output: Scoped evidence packet and reviewed remediation Work
workflows.verification: Confirm evidence freshness and match the reviewed decision to the correct obligation or control version.
workflows.note: Keep compliance findings connected to the evidence reviewed and the responsible owner.

skills.name: Review connector activation readiness
skills.output: Connector activation brief with allowed scope and missing readiness evidence
skills.note: Compare the selected catalog route with the tenant's observed activation and verification evidence.

skills.name: Review Spine Network MCP access
skills.output: Access review with effective capability scope and policy dependencies
skills.note: Confirm the capability scope the signed-in actor can use through Spine Network MCP.

skills.name: Verify an IW-Continuity handoff
skills.output: Continuity verification brief with matched Work, decisions and outstanding steps
skills.note: Compare authorized source and destination context for the same shared Work.

workflows.name: Connector activation verification
workflows.trigger: A tenant administrator requests activation of an approved Marketplace connector.

approval.reviewer: Authorized tenant administrator and account owner
approval.requiredFor: Binding the exact provider account and granting capability access

workflows.output: Tenant-scoped activation evidence with permitted capabilities and a readback result
workflows.verification: Confirm the signed-in binding, granted scope and authorized readback for the selected account.
workflows.note: Verify the Marketplace-to-Platform activation path through identity, consent, binding and readback.

workflows.name: Verify cross-host Work resume
workflows.trigger: An authorized user requests to resume Work from another approved host.

approval.requiredFor: Confirming the recipient and permitted handoff context

workflows.output: Resume checkpoint with verified Work ID, decisions and next action
workflows.verification: Read back the same Work on the destination through Spine Network MCP and compare the scoped IW-Continuity references with Platform.
workflows.note: Verify cross-host continuity while retaining the effective workspace and actor grants.
